messages:
nate: Heads up — customer reported double-token charge when a streaming reconnect coincided with a truncated tool call. Console shows final tokens > sum of parts. session s-9a4f in logs. Anyone seen this before?

lia: saw something similar in prod Friday. quick repro available?

nate: repro steps i used: client opens stream -> emits toolcall mid-stream -> network hiccup -> client reconnects with resume token -> server accepts and returns truncated toolcall ack. Billing ledger shows tokens for pre-hiccup chunk AND resumed chunk. logs snippet: `stream.start(s-9a4f) -> toolcall(id=tc-77) -> chunk(200 tokens) -> disconnect -> resume(token=R123) -> toolcall(id=tc-77-trunc) -> chunk(150 tokens)` result: charged 350 even though truncation should have removed the last 100.

sam: sounds like provisional accounting is applied on first arrival and not reconciled when truncated on resume. We add provisional ledger entries on chunk accept, then on resume we create new entries and never subtract the earlier provisional.

alex: caveat: some clients intentionally re-issue toolcall with a new id when they resume. If we dedupe too aggressively by toolcall id we might undercount legitimate retries. Need a robust dedupe key.

maria: from console UX pov customers freak out when "estimated" > "final" in billing widget. We should label provisional clearly, but ideally avoid visible double-counts.

lia: telemetry idea: emit metrics for provisional_tokens_added, provisional_tokens_released, finalized_tokens, with labels reason=(reconnect|truncation|toolcall_reissue). That will let us quantify how often truncation causes over-reserve.

sam: internal API proposal: emit a token event per accepted chunk: { session_id, sequence, toolcall_id?, token_delta, provisional:true/false }. Reconciler can then apply idempotency/dedupe rules: prefer (session_id, toolcall_id) when toolcall_id present; else fallback to (session_id, prefix_checksum).

alex: here's a strawman for token event:```json
{"session_id":"s-9a4f","seq":42,"toolcall_id":"tc-77","token_delta":200,"provisional":true}
```

sam: reconciler logic pseudocode:```py
if event.toolcall_id:
  key = (session_id, toolcall_id)
else:
  key = (session_id, prefix_hash)
if key_seen_before and event.provisional:
  if event.is_resume and event.toolcall_id_changed:
    // apply resume reconciliation: subtract earlier provisional if checksum overlaps
    reconcile_overlap(prev, event)
  else:
    ignore_duplicate()
else:
  apply_delta(event)
```

alex: we also need a resume_id field so server can indicate whether this resume should replace previous partial tool output or be appended. That semantics will help the ledger pick replace vs append.

maria: UX rollout: show a yellow "Provisional tokens (under review)" row in billing dashboard. Do not include provisional in customer-facing invoice until finalized. Internally still reserve quota.

nate: routing note — we could reduce freq of reconnects by sticky routing / host affinity for a short handoff window, but that's infra-heavy. Might reduce incidents but won't fix truncation semantics.

lia: action items: @sam prototype dedupe + reconcile logic (INF-4312), @alex add resume_id & explicit resume semantics to internal token API (INF-4313), @maria draft console copy and provisional styling (INF-4314), @lia will add telemetry metrics and dashboards (INF-4315). target: spike this sprint, GA in next.

dev-bot: Created INF-4312, INF-4313, INF-4314, INF-4315 and linked to this thread: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4312

nate: thanks — ping me when the prototype is wired into staging so we can run the customer repro. :+1:
